run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways a boolean expression with T/F symbols and operators evaluates to True
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameter sets of symbols, operators, and expression length
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that solves the boolean parenthesization problem
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a bottom-up DP table for counting true evaluations of boolean expressions
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness when handling AND, OR, and XOR operators in boolean expressions
